name: nfc-colliding-role-keys-rejected
description: An entities map carrying the same role key twice, once composed (NFC) and once decomposed (NFD), is refused as a duplicate: the two spellings are byte-distinct but normalise to the identical string.
notes: The two entities keys are byte-distinct code point sequences ('café' via composed U+00E9 versus 'café' via e U+0065 plus combining acute U+0301), so an ordinary strict parse sees two keys and passes -- the collision only appears once NFC normalisation runs, downstream of strict parse. Per schemas/vectors/README.md's stance that a byte-identical duplicate and an NFC-colliding duplicate are the same defect, this still refuses as duplicate_keys, never merges. input_bytes is required: re-serialising either key through a tool's own JSON writer could normalise away the exact byte-level distinction under test.
